report.title: DPDPA 2023 Compliance Report - Database Activity Monitoring
report.author: DBDOME Security Team (dbexpert.ai)

sections.text: DPDPA 2023 - Database Activity Monitoring Compliance Report

sections.content: Compliance evidence for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules, generated automatically by the DBDOME platform. Sections map to DPDPA Rule 6 (reasonable security safeguards), Rule 7 (personal data breach notification) and Rule 15 (cross-border transfer of personal data).

sections.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT server) AS monitored_servers, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS detection_rules, COUNT(*) AS total_executions, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_findings, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' IN ('high','critical') AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_findings FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
sections.template: In the last 24 hours: {monitored_servers} databases monitored, {detection_rules} detection rules executed, {total_executions} checks performed. Confirmed findings: {confirmed_findings} ({high_findings} high/critical).

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS control, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS items_found, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','medium') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-PRI%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

sections.text: 2.2 Least Privilege & Segregation of Duties Violations

sections.query: SELECT rule_name, action_type, attempted_by, resource_id, violation_reason, detected_at, CASE WHEN acknowledged_at IS NULL THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'ACKNOWLEDGED' END AS status FROM log.sod_violations WHERE detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS control, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','medium') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ENC%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-NET%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_breaches, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gdpr_notification_due < now() AND gdpr_notified_at IS NULL) AS overdue_notifications, COALESCE(SUM(affected_records_count),0) AS affected_records FROM log.incidents WHERE involves_personal_data IS TRUE AND state NOT IN ('CLOSED','RESOLVED')
sections.template: Open personal-data incidents: {open_breaches}. Notifications overdue (past the Rule 7 window and not yet notified): {overdue_notifications}. Personal-data records affected: {affected_records}.

sections.query: SELECT incident_id, title, severity, state, affected_records_count, detected_at, gdpr_notification_due, gdpr_notified_at FROM log.incidents WHERE involves_personal_data IS TRUE AND detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 25

sections.text: 4. Rule 15 - Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Data

sections.query: SELECT destination_country, SUM(transfer_count) AS transfers FROM log.v_cross_border_summary GROUP BY destination_country ORDER BY transfers DESC LIMIT 12
sections.title: Cross-Border Data Transfers by Destination Country
sections.caption: Detected outbound personal-data transfers grouped by destination country

sections.text: 4.1 Transfers Without a Recorded Legal Basis (highest risk)

sections.query: SELECT source_server, destination_server, destination_country, transfer_mechanism, db_user, table_name, risk_level, detected_at FROM log.cross_border_transfers WHERE has_legal_basis IS NOT TRUE AND detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT table_name, rows_hashed, last_hashed_id, verified_at, CASE WHEN is_valid THEN 'INTACT' ELSE 'BROKEN' END AS chain_status, broken_at_id FROM log.hash_chain_checkpoints ORDER BY verified_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT server) AS servers, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS rules_checked, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS findings FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
sections.template: Weekly summary: {servers} databases monitored across {rules_checked} detection rules; {findings} confirmed findings. Continuous monitoring provides the demonstrable safeguards, breach-detection and cross-border visibility required by DPDPA 2023.
